title: Deep genomic characterization of pediatric AML patients, Targeted RNAseq
description: Mutations and copy number changes of 141 myeloid genes as well as the fusion gene spectrum were investigated in 147 pediatric AML patients to identify new mutational patterns, disease mechanisms, prognosticators and genetic dependencies.
